name: University of Alberta
description: The University of Alberta is a public research university in Edmonton, Alberta, founded in 1908. It is one of Canada's largest universities, with faculties including engineering, business, science and nursing.
whyIncluded: The University of Alberta is among the 10 universities in Canada most chosen by international students (5,457 international undergraduates and 3,090 international graduate students in 2023-24), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: University of Alberta's own monthly estimate for Edmonton: a room in a shared off-campus flat, groceries, the mandatory U-Pass transit pass, health insurance (UAHIP), course-materials fee and personal spending, for an 8-month (two-semester) year.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A. U of A 'Estimated Expenses' page for incoming students (Alberta School of Business international office), figures per month / per 4-month semester, page undated (U-Pass C$182.50/semester and UAHIP C$53/month are the 2025-26 rates), so year recorded as 2025 and months as 8 (two semesters). housing = midpoint of 'off-campus, shared, unfurnished, no meals C$1,100-2,000/month' (on-campus single room is 1,400-2,000, shared room 1,100-1,500); food = midpoint of 'groceries/meals off campus C$400-800' (voluntary on-campus meal plan is 800); transport = mandatory U-Pass C$182.50 per 4-month semester = 45.63/month; personal = activities midpoint 200 + personal expenses (phone, laundry) midpoint 200 + mandatory UAHIP health insurance 53 + undergraduate course-materials access fee C$259/semester = 64.75/month, total 517.75. Tuition, travel, visa fees and entertainment beyond 'activities' excluded. Other U of A pages checked gave no undergraduate itemisation: ISS Budgeting (only a C$2,000 first-month settling-in figure), exchange 'Tuition and Cost of Living' (calculator only), graduate cost-of-living estimate (one-bedroom budget based on 2016-17 data) and MBA 2025-26 estimate (one-bedroom flat).

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Engineering (BSc Eng)
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international students starting in 2026, fixed by the university's tuition guarantee for the normal length of the degree plus one year. Compulsory fees (which rise yearly) included; health insurance extra.
programmes.notes: University of Alberta Board of Governors approved motions, 28 March 2025, Attachment 1 'Fall 2026: Proposed Tuition Rates for Incoming International Student (Cohort Model)', undergraduate row 'Faculty of Engineering': 2026-27 programme total C$199,809.60 (2025-26 cohort C$191,025.60) for a 4-year degree, so annual = total / 4. International undergraduate tuition is guaranteed for the typical programme length plus one year (Registrar, international tuition page). Compulsory = 2026-27 full-time undergraduate non-instructional fees per term from the Registrar (https://www.ualberta.ca/registrar/costs-tuition-fees/noninstructional-fees.html): student health and wellness 70.24 + academic success 98.00 + student experience support 94.04 + enrolment support 98.36 + Students' Union membership 64.22 + SU dedicated 89.06 + PAW Centre 29.00 + U-Pass 182.50 + athletics and recreation 104.88 = C$830.30 x 2 terms = C$1,660.60; opt-out SU health plan (204.93), SU dental plan (199.84) and course material access (259.00) excluded. 2025 row: tuition from the 2025-26 cohort programme total / 4; no 2025-26 fee table read, so the current fee amount applies. No 2024 figure found. Engineering rose 4.6% for the 2026 cohort (10% for other faculties).

programmes.name: Master of Engineering (MEng)
programmes.summary: Programme tuition for international students starting the course-based MEng in 2026, shown as one year (it takes 1 to 2 years; the tuition is a fixed programme total). Compulsory fees included; health insurance extra.
programmes.notes: Board of Governors approved motions 28 March 2025, Attachment 1, graduate course-based row 'Master's in Engineering (All Specializations)': programme total C$52,533.20 for the 2026-27 cohort (2025-26: C$47,757.52), +10%. The Faculty of Engineering MEng page says 1-2 years, 8-9 courses and a capstone; it also shows an older 'International: $39,500 for new students' figure, which is superseded by the Board-approved rate. Recorded as durationYears 1 with the whole programme total, so the programme cost is right if finished in 12 months. Compulsory = 2026-27 full-time graduate non-instructional fees per Fall/Winter term (https://www.ualberta.ca/en/graduate-studies/fees-funding/tuition-fees/non-instructional.html): academic success 98.00, student experience 94.04, enrolment support 98.36, health and wellness 70.24, athletics and recreation 104.88, PAW 29.00, GSA 81.37, GSA dedicated 1.00, graduate student assistance program 10.90, campus food bank 3.00, non-Indigenous 1.50, U-Pass 182.50 = C$774.79 x 2 = C$1,549.58; opt-out GSA health and dental plans and any spring/summer fees excluded.
